question: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS) aims to provide _________ crore young Indians with 12-month paid internships in the nation's top companies over the next five years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS)** is an ambitious program launched by the Government of India to provide youth with meaningful employment opportunities. 
• The scheme aims to provide **1 crore young Indians** with 12-month paid internships in the nation's top companies over the next five years. 
• It is designed to equip Indian youth with **practical skills and corporate exposure** to enhance their employability and professional growth. 
• The program will partner with leading companies across India, ensuring a variety of industrial sectors are covered, including IT, manufacturing, education, healthcare, and more. 
• The initiative aligns with the government's broader goal of addressing **youth unemployment** and encouraging skill development as part of India's demographic dividend. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Objectives of PMIS:** 
• To create a structured pathway for youth to transition from education to employment. 
• To ensure the participation of India's corporate sector in addressing the unemployment challenge. 
• To provide interns with a stipend and financial support during their internship tenure. 
• **Eligibility Criteria:** 
• Applicants should be **Indian nationals** aged between 18 and 30 years. 
• They must have at least completed their **secondary education** or an equivalent qualification. 
• Preference may be given to individuals from economically weaker sections or marginalized communities. 
• **Implementation:** 
• The scheme will be implemented in collaboration with **private companies, public sector enterprises, and non-governmental organizations.** 
• Internships will cover various domains such as **technology, finance, marketing, human resources, and operations.** 
• The government will provide financial incentives to participating companies to encourage their involvement in the program. 
• **Expected Outcomes:** 
• Enhanced **employability** of Indian youth through skill development and on-the-job training. 
• Increased participation of the private sector in **nation-building initiatives.** 
• A reduction in the overall **youth unemployment rate** in India. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Global Context:** Several countries, including the USA and Germany, have implemented similar internship programs to bridge the gap between education and employment. 
• **Skill Development in India:** The PMIS complements other initiatives like **Skill India** and **National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme** (NAPS). 
• **Monitoring and Evaluation:** The scheme will be monitored by a dedicated government task force to ensure its effectiveness and scalability. </ul
